### Christ Our King
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/christ-king
Passage: Revelation 17:14
Points:
- Troubling world events and pervasive injustice create a deep human longing for a wise, protective ruler.
- Scripture reveals Jesus as King of kings, ensuring that current spiritual struggles and defeats are only temporary.
- Christ holds supreme authority over all earthly rulers, meaning every power must ultimately answer to Him.
- All humanity will eventually bow before Him, either in joyful submission or under final judgment.
- Believers are called to serve as ambassadors, proclaiming Christ's reign and urging others to surrender to Him.

### Bible Pathways - Dec. 29, 2007
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-dec-29-2007-11562731.html
Passage: Revelation 17
Points:
- Prophetic imagery warns of an unholy alliance between corrupt political power and apostate religion.
- False religious movements compromise divine truth by promoting broad popular appeal over the exclusive gospel.
- Rebellious worldly forces will ultimately unite to wage war against Jesus Christ.
- The Lamb will decisively conquer all opposition because He is Lord of lords and King of kings.
- Believers share in His final victory as His called, chosen, and faithful followers.
